# LeViT-128S

Classification · `levit-128s_224x224` · DX-APP C++ example

Classification model, evaluated on ImageNet.

**Input** 224 × 224 × 3 · **Dataset** ImageNet · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Master

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/image_classification/levit/levit-128s_224x224/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models levit_128s_224x224
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target levit-128s_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/levit-128s_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/levit-128s_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/levit/levit-128s_224x224/levit-128s_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/levit-128s_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```
